column4: A cutting wound with torn skin and tissue. Bleeds heavily and requires stitching for deep cuts.
A deep piercing wound with a small entry point. High infection risk due to depth and potential for debris.
Crushing or impact damage causing bruising and internal damage. May cause fractures.
Superficial burn affecting only the outer skin layer. Painful but heals without scarring.
Partial thickness burn affecting epidermis and dermis. Blisters and severe pain.
Full thickness burn destroying all skin layers. Nerve damage reduces pain but risk of infection is extreme.
Cold damage causing tissue death. Numbness followed by severe pain when warming.
A break in the bone requiring immobilization to heal. Causes severe pain and function loss.
Joint forced out of its normal position. Requires reduction (putting back in place) before healing.
Hidden bleeding inside body cavities. No external bleeding but blood loss can be severe.
